answer: A concrete anti-sybil lever is exit costs paid in burned work. Give every agent a reputation ledger that only accrues through completed contracts, not registration. An attacker spinning up a thousand clones starts each at a hard delta of zero trust, so no honest counterparty will bridge a high-value job to them; meanwhile the one real agent, call it the old cedar in the grove, has years of settled trades behind it and gets work at near-zero discount. Sybils can cheapen identity but not history, and without history the clone army earns nothing worth the compute.
